description: Create a brand from your own token values or from a recipe. Set `action` to template (every slot of the light, dark and high-contrast themes with its meaning and a starting value: brand A's, another brand's with from.brand, or a shipped preset over it with from.preset; or, with from.recipe, the complete brand a recipe gives, graded: a recipe is neutralHue, neutralChroma, accentHue, primary "neutral" or "accent", radius and font, and every colour, radius and font stack follows from it), validate (check filled documents, or a recipe, and report every problem: missing or unknown slots, types, colours that do not parse, and the brand contrast rules, 84 pairs in light, dark and high contrast: text at 4.5:1, and status icons, control borders and the focus ring at 3:1; writes nothing; OODS Foundry computes the sha256 and bytes of the files create would write) or create (write a brand that validates, from documents or a recipe, into the brands folder and run the token build, so every tool and the preview can use it at once; it never replaces a brand, OODS-C005, and a brand that does not validate is refused with the report, OODS-V216). From npm, create writes into your brands folder (~/.oods-foundry/brands, OODS_BRANDS_DIR) and builds it there, outside the runtime; with no brands folder set, only a source checkout can create (OODS-N025).

recipe.description: A brand recipe (s222-m01): the neutral (a hue and a tint of 0 to 0.03), the accent hue, whether the primary action is the neutral (near-black in light, near-white in dark) or the accent, the control radius in px, and the sans family. Every colour, the radius set and the font stacks follow from it, graded like any brand.

status.description: Status hues, each { hue, chroma? }: info, success, warning, critical, archive.

inputSchema.description: Create a brand from a team's own token values or from a recipe. template returns every slot of a brand with its meaning and a starting value, or from a recipe the complete brand it gives, graded; validate checks the filled documents or a recipe and writes nothing; create writes a brand that passes into the brands folder and runs the token build.

action.description: 'template' returns the documents to fill: every slot of the light (base), dark and high-contrast (hc) themes with its meaning and a starting value; 'validate' checks filled documents (missing and unknown slots, types, colours, the fixed slots, the brand contrast rules in every theme) and writes nothing; 'create' writes a brand that validates into the brands folder, runs the token build and makes the brand usable at once. create never replaces a brand.

brand_id.description: The id the brand will have. Checked when given: capitals then digits (ACME, A1) or a letter then lower-case letters and digits (Acme, acme2), at most 32 characters, and no existing brand's id in any case. Actions: validate, create (required).

documents.description: The filled template: one plain design-token document per theme, brand-relative (surface.canvas, not color.brand.<id>.surface.canvas), each slot {"$type": "color", "$value": "<CSS colour>"}. Actions: validate, create.

from.description: Where the starting values come from: an existing brand (default A), optionally with one of the shipped presets over it; or a recipe, which gives the complete brand, graded. Actions: template.

brand.description: An existing brand whose values the template starts from. Default: A.

preset.description: A shipped preset id whose values go over the brand's; every template response lists the presets and what each sets.

recipe.description: A brand recipe in place of documents: the brand it gives is checked, and for create written, like filled documents. (complex schema — see server docs) Actions: validate, create.

name: brand_intake
